rows.organization: Afghan mujahidin resistance parties and the Afghan Interim Government
rows.note: The USDOS report covering 1989 describes sustained organized resistance and the formation of the Afghan Interim Government by major resistance parties in February 1989. The January 1980 Defense Intelligence Agency memorandum independently records an alliance of six religious resistance party leaders. Islamist is the game's coarse classification of diverse religious organizations, not a claim that their doctrines were identical. This record establishes existence only: it does not turn territory, armed strength or qualitative support into a vote percentage. The 1989 report notes its reliance on unofficial sources after the US embassy closed.
